bracketGoal: No Game Changers · budget list · Aura combo OK at your table
name: Zaxara: Hail Hydra
notes: Plan: ramp into Zaxara, then cast X spells. Every X spell also makes an X-sized Hydra token, including instants and sorceries.
Budget build: the list swaps out 12 cards priced above $10. They now sit in Cards to add with prices and their replacements. Prices are rough Nov 2026 web listings, so recheck them before buying.
Freed from the Real and Pemmin's Aura stay in by request. Pemmin's runs about $11–13 and Freed about $7–11, and both are already listed in Tom's Bombs.
Land speed: no fetch or shock lands in this version, and the three pain lands stay. Opulent Palace, Temple of Mystery, Path of Ancestry and Jungle Hollow are the slower fixers.

Freed from the Real or Pemmin's Aura on Zaxara: tap her for {U}{U}, pay {U} to untap, and net {U} each time. Tap her for the other colors once you have enough blue. It needs her without summoning sickness.
Incubation Druid works too once it has a +1/+1 counter: it taps for three of any type your lands can make, so the untap nets two.
Infinite mana wins with Exsanguinate, Hydra Broodmaster's monstrosity, or Diabolic Revelation for X=everything you need. Blue Sun's Zenith also digs, but keep your own library above zero.
Pemmin's Aura has other jobs: {U} for flying on your biggest Hydra, or {U} for shroud in response to removal. Shroud stops you targeting that creature too.
Gargos in the 99: Hydra spells cost {4} less, so Hungering Hydra at X=4 costs {G} and still makes a 4/4 token.
Hardened Scales and Kami of Whispered Hopes each add a counter to anything getting counters, and they stack.
Farseek can't fetch a Forest. Take an Island or a Swamp.
Official Bracket 2 guidance doesn't expect two-card infinite combos, so mention it if you play with a new table.

Copies still shared with other decks: Branching Evolution and Kami of Whispered Hopes are in The Astonishing Ant-Man; Exsanguinate is in Doom Unrivaled; Hardened Scales and Snakeskin Veil are in The Astonishing Ant-Man; Overwhelming Stampede is in several decks.

variants.name: Zaxara: Hail Hydra (B3)
notes: Game Changers (3): Cyclonic Rift, Seedborn Muse, Demonic Tutor. Freed from the Real and Pemmin's Aura stay in.
Shock lands return here because your land-speed concern was about Bracket 2. They replace Opulent Palace, Temple of Mystery and Exotic Orchard.
Seedborn Muse untaps Zaxara and your mana every opponent's turn, so instant X spells make tokens all around the table.

Copies: Cyclonic Rift is in the Lawyer Deck; Demonic Tutor is in Tom's Bombs, Doom Unrivaled and Winter Soldier; the shock lands are in Ant-Man, Thanos & Obosh and the Doom/Norman decks. Seedborn Muse isn't listed in the vault.

B3 cards above $10: Seedborn Muse about $18 (not in the vault), Cyclonic Rift about $39 (in the Lawyer Deck), Demonic Tutor about $65 (in three of your decks). Shock land prices weren't checked. The base list's budget swaps carry over here.
